guidance.procedure: Map the hypothesis and each operative clause by actor, force, action, object, trigger, condition, exception and scope; background, headings and adjacency do not establish a relation. For return-on-termination, require return or destruction tied to termination, expiration or a comparable end event; request-only duties are insufficient, and retention needs express permission. Treat independent development and third-party receipt separately: only explicit matching conditions count, never an exclusion heading or generic source language. Oral coverage requires oral, verbal, spoken or intangible-form language. Universal express-identification is contradicted when confidentiality may arise from reasonable understanding, circumstances or express dispensation; marking rules support it only if comprehensive. Technical-only coverage is contradicted only by an operative protected-information definition containing substantive nontechnical categories, not transaction context or generic information references. Employee permission never establishes nonemployee sharing; contradiction requires a governing disclosure ban broad enough to cover that actor, cited with any exclusive employee exception. For solicitation, exclude contact limits and collect every independent solicitation restriction. No-license clauses must tie rights to protected information, its embodiments or defined results, not the agreement generally. Agreement confidentiality includes protected existence, terms, negotiations or publicity or use of the agreement itself; name-use alone is insufficient. Copy permission requires an operative necessary-purpose exception; consent-conditioned bans remain opposition. Cite every independently responsive member and necessary scope language; exclude headings and adjacency.

Map actor, force, action, object, trigger, condition, exception and quantifier before classifying. Return-on-termination requires return or destruction tied to an end event, including performance required before termination; request-only return is insufficient. Retention requires an express exception; only a comprehensive all-form disposition duty can oppose it. Independent development and third-party receipt require their own matching clauses. Technical-only is opposed by substantive nontechnical protected categories, not generic breadth alone. Oral coverage needs oral, verbal, spoken or intangible language. Universal identification holds only when all protection is conditioned on marking or notice; reasonable-understanding, regardless-of-marking or an unconditional broad definition opposes it, despite supplemental marking language. Employee access never proves nonemployee sharing; consent-conditioned disclosure to advisers or others is opposition, not standing permission. Contact controls are not solicitation; use only solicit, hire, employ or induce restrictions and collect repetitions. No-license evidence must concern protected information, its embodiments or defined work; ownership or assignment away may support it, but use limits and transaction disclaimers do not. Agreement confidentiality includes existence, terms, negotiations, publicity, protected counterparty identities or deal arrangements. Copying allowed only by an operative purpose exception; consent-conditioned bans oppose. Absolute bans on using protected information for design, development or manufacture can support reverse-engineering restriction. Cite every independently responsive operative member, excluding headings and merely adjacent text.

operations.rationale: Parent and draft native feedback showed recurring relation errors involving request versus termination, consent-conditioned prohibitions, employees versus nonemployee representatives, universal marking scope, contact versus solicitation, and unrelated clauses used for licensing or independent-development conclusions. The draft preserved label accuracy but worsened evidence precision and recall, including omissions of repeated operative members. This final revision retains the effective source inspector while narrowing the interpretive rules and adding the observed reverse-engineering distinction.
